---
title: "Heatmap - subject variability of highly subject specific functional genes"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r}
# set seed
set.seed(4)

# load libraries
library(Seurat)
library(pheatmap)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)


# load data
nrchd_gene_df<-read.csv("/Users/leon/Documents/NICA/sc_analysis/data/supp_tables_S10.csv") # bulk rna enriched genesets
bulk_subj_var_gene_df<-read.csv("/Users/leon/Documents/NICA/sc_analysis/data/supp_tables_S9.csv") # bulk rna subject variance
rownames(bulk_subj_var_gene_df)<-bulk_subj_var_gene_df$Gene
enrichment_df<-readRDS("/Users/leon/Documents/NICA/sc_analysis/data/NICA_batch2to4_new_timepoints_fsex_subject_enriched_with_labels.rds") # single cell rna enriched genesets
enrichment_df<-enrichment_df[str_detect(enrichment_df$pathway,"btm"),]
vpars<-readRDS("/Users/leon/Documents/NICA/sc_analysis/data/NICA_batch2to4_new_timepoints_cleaned_normalized_fsex_vpars_object.rds") # single cell gene-wise variance partition
inh<-read.csv("/Users/leon/Documents/NICA/sc_analysis/data/inheritability_data_pvals.csv") # hertability data of gene expression (Wright et al 2014, Nat Genet.)
inh777<-read.csv("/Users/leon/Documents/NICA/sc_analysis/data/inheritability_data_777.csv")
inh777<-inh777$X
inh777<-inh[which(inh$probe.id %in% inh777),]$gene.symbol
```

```{r}
# adapt loaded geneset list
genesetl<-list()
for (i in seq(1,nrow(nrchd_gene_df))){
  gset<-unlist(str_split(nrchd_gene_df$leadingEdge[i]," "))
  genesetl[[paste(str_split(nrchd_gene_df$pathway[i],"_")[[1]][2:3],collapse="_")]]<-gset
}


# reformat subject variance data
ledge<-unique(unlist(enrichment_df$leadingEdge))
vpars_h<-vpars[c("subject_variance_explained","celltype","gene")]
vpars_h<-vpars_h[which(!(vpars_h$celltype %in% c("ILC","doublets"))),]
vpars_h<-reshape(vpars_h, idvar = "gene", timevar = "celltype", direction = "wide")
vpars_h[is.na(vpars_h)]<-0
genes<-vpars_h$gene
vpars_h<-vpars_h[which(colnames(vpars_h)!="gene")]
vpars_h<-sapply(vpars_h, as.numeric)
row.names(vpars_h)<-genes
colnames(vpars_h)<-as.vector(sapply(colnames(vpars_h),function(x){str_split_i(x,"\\.",2)}))
vpars_h<-vpars_h[which(rownames(vpars_h) %in% unlist(ledge)),]


# collect and reformat heatmap annotations
ledge_list<-list()
for (pway in unique(enrichment_df$pathway)){ 
  ledge<-unique(unlist(enrichment_df[which(enrichment_df$pathway==pway),]$leadingEdge))
  pway<-str_split_i(pway,"btm_",2)
  ledge_list[[pway]]<-ledge
}

#leading edge genes from bulk enriched pathways
p_annot_l<-list()
for (p in names(ledge_list)){
    p_annot<-as.numeric(rownames(vpars_h) %in% ledge_list[[p]])
    if(str_detect(p,"M61") | str_detect(p,"M7.2")){
      p_annot<-as.numeric(rownames(vpars_h) %in% ledge_list[["M61.0_enriched in NK cells (II)"]] | rownames(vpars_h) %in% ledge_list[["M7.2_enriched in NK cells (I)"]])
      p="M7.2_M61_enriched in NK cells (I/II)"
    }
    if(str_detect(p,"M11") | str_detect(p,"M118")){
      p_annot<-as.numeric(rownames(vpars_h) %in% ledge_list[["M11.0_enriched in monocytes (II)"]] | rownames(vpars_h) %in% ledge_list[["M118.0_enriched in monocytes (IV)"]])
      p="M11_M118_enriched in monocytes (II/IV)"
    }
    if(str_detect(p,"M69") | str_detect(p,"M47") | str_detect(p,"M47.2")){
      p_annot<-as.numeric(rownames(vpars_h) %in% ledge_list[["M47.0_enriched in B cells (I)"]] | rownames(vpars_h) %in% ledge_list[["M47.2_enriched in B cells (III)"]] | rownames(vpars_h) %in% ledge_list[["M69_enriched in B cells (VI)"]])
      p="M47_M47.2_M69_enriched in B cells (I/III/VI)"
    }
    if(p=="M5.0_regulation of antigen presentation and immune response"){
      p<-"M5.0_regulation of antigen presentation & immune response        "
    }

    p_annot_l[[p]]<-p_annot
}
p_annot_l<-as.data.frame(do.call(cbind,p_annot_l))
rownames(p_annot_l)<-rownames(vpars_h)
p_annot_l<-p_annot_l[!str_detect(colnames(p_annot_l),"extracell")]
p_annot_l<-p_annot_l[!str_detect(colnames(p_annot_l),"cell cycle")]
p_annot_l<-p_annot_l[!str_detect(colnames(p_annot_l),"regulation in cell")]

#inheritable gens
p_annot<-as.numeric(rownames(vpars_h) %in% inh777)
p_annot_l$"HERITABILITY (Wright et al.,Nature Genetics 2014)"<-p_annot

#clusterID
p<-pheatmap(t(vpars_h), scale="none", clustering_distance_cols="correlation", cutree_cols = 4, silent = T)

#subjectVar bulk RNA
p_annot_l$VES_bulk<-bulk_subj_var_gene_df[rownames(p_annot_l),]$Subject.ID

# plot heatmap
p_annot_l$clusterid<-NULL
pheatmap(t(vpars_h), scale="none", main="all", fontsize_row=12, fontsize=8, fontsize_col = 1, legend = TRUE, annotation_legend = FALSE ,annotation_col=p_annot_l, clustering_distance_cols="correlation", cutree_cols = 4, color=magma(100))
```



```{r}
#visualize variance partitioning for top20 genes per main cluster
p_annot_l$clusterid<-cutree(p$tree_col, k = 4)[rownames(vpars_h)]

#var_b (Bcell dominated cluster)
var_b<-vpars[vpars$gene %in% row.names(p_annot_l[which(p_annot_l$clusterid==4),]),]
var_b<-var_b %>% group_by(gene) %>% dplyr::slice(which.max(subject_variance_explained)) %>% as.data.frame()
var_b<-head(var_b[order(var_b$subject_variance_explained, decreasing = T),],20)
colnames(var_b)<-c("batch","Subject","Sex","Residuals","Age","celltype","gene")
var_b<-melt(var_b[c("Subject","Sex","Residuals","Age","gene")])
scale_df<-as.data.frame(var_b %>% group_by(gene) %>% summarize(scalefactor=1/sum(value)))
var_b<-merge(var_b,scale_df,)
var_b$value<-var_b$value*var_b$scalefactor
var_b<-var_b[order(var_b$value, decreasing = T),]
var_b$variable<-factor(var_b$variable,levels=c("Residuals","Age","Sex","Subject"))
p2<-ggplot(data=var_b,aes(y=gene,x=value,group=variable,fill=variable))+geom_bar(stat='identity',colour="black",size=0.25)+scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(head(var_b,20)$gene)) + theme_classic() + labs(title="Bcells") + scale_fill_manual(values=c("white","#619CFF","#00BA38","#F8766D")) 

var_b$heritability<-NA
var_b$heritability[which(var_b$gene %in% inh777)]<-1
p1 <- ggplot(var_b, aes(x = 0,  y = gene, size=factor(heritability), color="red")) +geom_point()+scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(head(var_b,20)$gene)) +theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(),panel.grid = element_blank())
pp1<-(p2 + theme(legend.position="none") | p1 + theme(legend.position="none")) + plot_layout(widths = c(10, 1))
```

```{r}
#visualize subject variance partitioning for selected immune response signatures

sigs<-ImmuneAgeStability::baseline_signatures[c("TGSig20","IHM","IFN","ia_bcell","iaa","GPR56highvslow_CD8_EM_sig","DE_CD29hi_CD8_genes")]
names(sigs)<-c("TGSig20","IHM","IFN","IAB B-cell","IAA","CD8 VM GPR56hi","CD8 VM CD29hi")
multisignature_stability_df<-ImmuneAgeStability::compute_multisignature_stability(sigs)
ImmuneAgeStability::plot_signature_stability_heatmap(multisignature_stability_df)
```
